title: Chicken Tagine with Mediterranean Flair
description: A rich and flavorful dish inspired by the Mediterranean, featuring tender chicken cooked in a fragrant tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken; cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine; bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
